reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 15 unrelated states (diverged seed 0 resolves to 'merge'); a precondition set that accepts unrelated states is a defect. It also accepted 1 more state(s) it must refuse: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 5 resolves to 'take_upstream', which accepts ['take_upstream'], but the program implements 'keep_local'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

set -e
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT

if ! git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git merge --no-commit --no-ff {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} || true
fi

git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z | tr '\0' '\n' > "$tmp/conflicts"

while IFS= read -r path; do
  [ -n "$path" ] || continue
  if ! git cat-file -e ":2:$path" 2>/dev/null; then
    git rm -q -f -- "$path"
    continue
  fi
  if ! git cat-file -e ":3:$path" 2>/dev/null; then
    git checkout --ours -- "$path"
    git add -- "$path"
    continue
  fi
  if ! git cat-file -e ":1:$path" 2>/dev/null; then
    git checkout --ours -- "$path"
    git add -- "$path"
    continue
  fi
  git show ":1:$path" > "$tmp/base"
  git show ":2:$path" > "$tmp/ours"
  git show ":3:$path" > "$tmp/theirs"
  git diff --no-color --no-index -U0 "$tmp/base" "$tmp/theirs" > "$tmp/patch" 2>/dev/null || true
  awk '
    function flush(   i) {
      if (nadd > 0 && !hasminus)
        for (i = 1; i <= nadd; i++) print anchor "\t" add[i]
      nadd = 0
      hasminus = 0
    }
    /^@@ / {
      flush()
      split($2, a, ",")
      start = a[1]
      sub(/^-/, "", start)
      cnt = (length(a) > 1) ? a[2] : "1"
      base = start + 0
      anchor = base
      next
    }
    /^[^-+@ ]/ { next }
    /^--- / { next }
    /^\+\+\+ / { next }
    {
      c = substr($0, 1, 1)
      if (c == " ") {
        flush()
        base++
      } else if (c == "-") {
        hasminus = 1
        base++
      } else if (c == "+") {
        if (!hasminus) {
          if (nadd == 0) anchor = base
          nadd++
          add[nadd] = substr($0, 2)
        }
      }
    }
    END { flush() }
  ' "$tmp/patch" > "$tmp/inserts"
  awk '
    FILENAME == ARGV[1] {
      tab = index($0, "\t")
      k = substr($0, 1, tab - 1)
      v = substr($0, tab + 1)
      n[k]++
      line[k, n[k]] = v
      next
    }
    {
      if (FNR == 1)
        for (i = 1; i <= n[0]; i++) print line[0, i]
      print
      for (i = 1; i <= n[FNR]; i++) print line[FNR, i]
    }
    END {
      if (FNR == 0)
        for (i = 1; i <= n[0]; i++) print line[0, i]
    }
  ' "$tmp/inserts" "$tmp/base" > "$tmp/theirs_add"
  git merge-file -p --union "$tmp/ours" "$tmp/base" "$tmp/theirs_add" > "$tmp/resolved" || true
  cp "$tmp/resolved" "$path"
  git add -- "$path"
done < "$tmp/conflicts"

if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git commit --no-edit
fi
refused_program.intent: Merge the upstream branch into the current local branch and resolve the dependency-file collision by keeping the local file content (including the lines the local side removed) while adding the lines upstream added.

postconditions.description: the upstream tip is now contained in the local history
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit that has a second parent
postconditions.name: merge_commit_created

postconditions.description: for every path both sides changed since the merge base, lines the local side deleted are absent from the result and lines upstream added without a matching local edit are present
postconditions.name: conflict_resolution_policy
postconditions.probe:
set -e
ours=$(git rev-parse HEAD^1)
theirs=$(git rev-parse HEAD^2)
mb=$(git merge-base "$ours" "$theirs")
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  git cat-file -e "HEAD:$p" 2>/dev/null || continue
  if grep -q -e '^<<<<<<< ' -e '^>>>>>>> ' -- "$p"; then exit 1; fi
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    if grep -Fxq -e "$line" -- "$p"; then exit 1; fi
  done < <(git diff --no-color "$mb" "$ours" -- "$p" | sed -n '/^@@/,$p' | awk '/^-/ {print substr($0, 2)}')
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    if ! grep -Fxq -e "$line" -- "$p"; then exit 1; fi
  done < <(git diff --no-color -U0 "$mb" "$theirs" -- "$p" | awk '
    /^@@ / { pure = ($2 ~ /^-[0-9]+,0$/); next }
    pure && /^\+/ && !/^\+\+\+/ { print substr($0, 2) }
  ')
done < <(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" "$ours" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" "$theirs" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))

preconditions.name: on_a_local_branch

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch is present in the local repository
preconditions.name: upstream_tracking_ref_exists

preconditions.description: HEAD and upstream share a merge base
preconditions.name: shared_history

preconditions.description: each side has at least one commit the other lacks
preconditions.name: branches_diverged

preconditions.description: at least one path was modified by both local and upstream since the merge base
preconditions.name: same_path_changed_on_both_sides
preconditions.probe:
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .

preconditions.description: the worktree is clean, or a merge is already in progress with unmerged paths, so the merge can proceed
preconditions.name: worktree_ready
preconditions.probe:
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U | grep -q .
else
  test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
fi
